top_signals.title: Forced Into the Right Decision? A Look at U.S. Land-Based Deterrence Posture
top_signals.summary:
In 2019, Steve Fetter wrote “A Cheaper Nuclear Sponge,” in which he argued that building a new intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) was unnecessary for strengthening U.S. land-based deterrence.
